post_deployment_incident.cause: Operator set host configuration mode0600 while retaining root ownership; the application runs asUID65534 and could not read it after restart.
post_deployment_incident.repair: Repaired exact host-file metadata, verified unchanged content digest and read/JSON parse under serviceUID65534. Final root ownership, group65534 and0640 mode grant service read but not write.
post_deployment_incident.recurrence_guard: Staged configuration now read-checked under service identity before replace. Synthetic root0600 refusal and final root/service-group0640 acceptance pass; live service-identity read and non-write checks pass. One intervening machine-exec response timed out and is retained without a success claim.
post_deployment_incident.remaining_issue: Cold startup took about ten minutes on the existing shared CPU and volume. Preserve full validation; measure startup stages before changing resource allocation or caching.

limits: No complete product acceptance or all-SDG supply claim.
Public Dot pages are editorial records, not a scheduler, upload endpoint or exclusive task queue.
